description: This source file implements functions related to traversing and managing git tree objects, including decoding tree entries, initializing tree descriptors, following symbolic links, and filtering tree entries based on pathspecs. It provides core logic for navigating the git object store and handling complex tree traversal scenarios.

methods.name: int decode_tree_entry(struct tree_desc * desc,const char * buf,unsigned long size,struct strbuf * err)
methods.description: Decodes a single tree entry from a buffer into a tree_desc structure, extracting mode, path, and object ID, with error handling for malformed entries.

methods.name: int init_tree_desc_internal(struct tree_desc * desc,const struct object_id * oid,const void * buffer,unsigned long size,struct strbuf * err,enum tree_desc_flags flags)
methods.description: Initializes a tree_desc structure with provided object ID, buffer, size, error buffer, and flags, decoding the first entry if present.

methods.name: void init_tree_desc(struct tree_desc * desc,const struct object_id * tree_oid,const void * buffer,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Public function to initialize a tree_desc with object ID and buffer, dying on error.

methods.name: int init_tree_desc_gently(struct tree_desc * desc,const struct object_id * oid,const void * buffer,unsigned long size,enum tree_desc_flags flags)
methods.description: Initializes a tree_desc structure with error reporting instead of dying, returning error codes.

methods.name: void * fill_tree_descriptor(struct repository * r,struct tree_desc * desc,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Reads a tree object from the repository given an object ID and initializes a tree_desc, returning the buffer.

methods.name: void setup_traverse_info(struct traverse_info * info,const char * base)
methods.description: Prepares a traverse_info structure with path information; registers atexit handler for statistics if tracing is enabled.

methods.name: char * make_traverse_path(char * path,size_t pathlen,const struct traverse_info * info,const char * name,size_t namelen)
methods.description: Constructs a traversal path string from a base, a name, and traversal info.

methods.name: void strbuf_make_traverse_path(struct strbuf * out,const struct traverse_info * info,const char * name,size_t namelen)
methods.description: Appends a traversal path to a strbuf based on traversal info and a name.

methods.name: int traverse_trees(struct index_state * istate,int n,struct tree_desc * t,struct traverse_info * info)
methods.description: Recursively traverses multiple git trees, filtering entries based on pathspecs, and invoking a callback for each relevant tree entry.

methods.name: int get_tree_entry(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * tree_oid,const char * name,struct object_id * oid,unsigned short * mode)
methods.description: Retrieves an object ID and mode given a repository, a tree object ID, and a filename, descending into subtrees if necessary.

methods.name: enum:get_oid_result get_tree_entry_follow_symlinks(struct repository * r,struct object_id * tree_oid,const char * name,struct object_id * result,struct strbuf * result_path,unsigned short * mode)
methods.description: Follows symlinks in tree objects to resolve actual objects, handling symlink chains and outside-repo links, returning the final object ID.

methods.name: int tree_entry(struct tree_desc * desc,struct name_entry * entry)
methods.description: Extracts the current tree entry and advances the tree descriptor to the next entry.

methods.name: int tree_entry_gently(struct tree_desc * desc,struct name_entry * entry)
methods.description: Extracts the current tree entry without dying on errors, instead marking the entry as cleared if unsuccessful.

methods.name: enum:interesting tree_entry_interesting(struct index_state * istate,const struct name_entry * entry,struct strbuf * base,const struct pathspec * ps)
methods.description: Determines if a tree entry is interesting based on the current pathspec filtering rules.

methods.name: int check_entry_match(const char * a,int a_len,const char * b,int b_len)
methods.description: Checks if a given tree entry name matches a pathspec match, considering sorting order and partial matches.
